_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. The mutation vocabulary belongs to ONE subset of ONE standard of ONE artifact, so the oracle registration and the catalog live here. `s.architect.program` is a semio-NATIVE artifact and no third party reads its carriers, so the reference is a SECOND IMPLEMENTATION in Python written from this subset's committed schemas, its derivation rules and its 266 specification vectors.

oracles.rationale:
A second implementation of the `s.architect.program` architectural-brief document and all 266 typed mutations, in Python, at `../../../../../🧪️tests/mutate-program-1/🐍️component.py`. Written from `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/🔣️component.json` (the 266 payload shapes: 66 `{id}`, 64 `{id,newName}`, 66 whole-record and six facet payloads), from `../🧬️schema/📸️snapshot/🔣️component.json` (the register list and its order), from rules 1, 2 and 4 of `.🧬semio/🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️12/SEMANTIC-MUTATIONS-OVERHAUL/📓️derivation-rules.md`, and from the 266 committed `(before, mutation, after, outcome)` specification vectors — which are the only statement of three facts: that a `connect-` verb NORMALISES the edge it appends, that an absent id is `mutation.target-missing` with the id as its path rather than a no-op, and that the 47th register is serialized `artifacts` although the committed JSON Schema requires `documents`. It imports nothing from this repository and transliterates none of its Rust; no file under `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/<slug>/{🦠️mutation,↩️inverse,🔺️diff}/🦀️component.rs` was read. This registration SUPERSEDES the `architect-program-mutation-semantics` no-oracle decision, whose argument — that a vocabulary derived by `📓️derivation-rules.md` is a specification no external implementation could confirm or refute — was refuted by the fifteen `📕️norm` references, which were written from that same document. A third-party library was declined, not merely absent: IFC and its property sets carry a built model rather than the brief that precedes it, requirements-management schemas (ReqIF, SysML) carry requirement records but no 66-register brief and no closed 266-verb algebra over it, and none of them reads this carrier. The reference REFUSES three of the case's scenarios by clause rather than adjudicating them, and says so in role: `create-knowledge-record` and `create-benchmark-record`, whose whole observable effect is a content address of a composed `s.stdio.semio@v1/table` child that no document in this repository defines; and `identity-round-trip`, whose `.dsl.semio` carrier has only the repository-wide placeholder grammar `payload = OCTET+` while the notation flattens nested records into `key=key=value` and every record `$def` in the committed JSON Schema is an empty `{"type": "object", "additionalProperties": true}` stub. `package` is deliberately empty: the implementation needs no distribution, so this entry contributes nothing to `🔒️dependencies.json`.

UNDER PROTOCOL V2 this registration is classified `cross-semio-implementation` — a required SUPPLEMENTAL oracle that does not discharge `program-1-mutate`'s external-oracle requirement for its 266-kind mutation vocabulary; a qualifying third-party reference (`third-party-library` / `third-party-cli` / `standards-reference-tool`) is still owed.
